rows.grounds: optative verb expressing a commanded division
ablative means or cause of division

items.question: How is the star to be divided eightfold by middle-half and turning?
premises: the middle half serves as means
items.inference: the verse prescribes an eightfold division of the star by middle-half and turning
uncertainties: exact doctrinal referent of tāra remains unspecified
items.plain_english: Let the star be divided eightfold by the middle half through turning.
